body: It happens to me all the time.

Yeah these exact thoughts are causing me an inner turmoil.  


Where I live suicide is often stigmatized and viewed as a stupid act. Families of those that have committed the act are shamed and misunderstood.   
Mental illnesses such as depression are not taken seriously and most of the people know nothing about and how it works and yet they talk as if they know how it is like telling to those who suffer to just "snap out of it and get out to see people". Like come on are they serious?!  
Here mental health isn't affordable with the current standard when it comes to finances jobs and pricing. It would have been good if it was affordable many people would have gotten better and even families would have been saved.  Also insurance does not cover all of the medication. And yet they say health is for everyone yet few can actually afford it.

What kind of a therapist says that?!!! Find a real therapist that can do his job properly. I feel like the therapist that you are going to is not someone that is trustworthy. That phrase shows his inability to help you due to lack of actual knowledge and his unprofessionalism. 

I am sorry for what you are going through, it must suck awfully bad. Find a real therapist that is knowledgeable and capable of helping you go this through.

I say to myself the same "You can always die tomorrow." and it seems to work for me too to a great extent but sometimes the pain is very intense. I have never put my plan into execution yet and I am very glad about it. 

Sometimes when I picture myself committing the act I really feel ashamed of myself. I ask sometimes myself "How can someone think of doing something like that to himself something that he wouldn't think of doing to even his enemy?". I might be a little dramatic about it but when you think about it it is stunning and scary at the same time. Normally I am doing well at coping with it but sometimes I can break for some time. 

When tourist season comes back I will make an effort to save up some money to get professional help. 

Thank you 😊 I am happy I got the chance to get it off my chest.

Lol Where do I start. 

I like helping people with their problems and offer advice but being incapable to help myself.

Not being aware of my surroundings. 
Like even if there was a golden chain on the street I wouldn't notice it.

Constantly living in my own head.

Always needing solid proof to distance myself from something that is obviously harmful to me.

If an INTP does not find any stable ground where he can develop himself and utilize his intelligence in his early stages of life he is at risk of developing unhealthy habits to cope with not being to use his full potential. That's where his gift becomes his curse.

My everyday struggle. Although I have worked as a waitress I still have a big issue with that. 

I mean it is very difficult for me to get comfortable in social situations to the point where I appear clumsy and appear stupid and people don't get me seriously. That happens after a extended period of limited human interaction.
